verdict.rationale: Auth0 is an identity and authorization platform, not an agent or AI client that consumes tools, so plugging MCP servers into it for its own use is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence fits that reading. The Auth0 MCP Server is a server-role offering that lets external AI tools manage a tenant. The 'connect to MCP servers' messaging is about securing customers' own agents, which is a developer building block rather than Auth0 itself acting as an MCP client.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
